# Videngine

> Videngine is a programmatic video engine built and run by Wall & Fifth Ltd. It turns a web page, a listing, a block of text or a row of data into a finished, narrated, captioned MP4, rendered from templates written as code rather than generated footage. It is built for video that repeats: property, vehicle and marketplace listing videos, product videos and ad variants, explainers from help articles and release notes, and YouTube videos and Shorts made from a website's pages. Videngine is coming soon, with plans from $79 a month.

## Key facts

- What it does: reads a source (a URL, plain text or markdown, a CSV or a JSON payload), writes a script, builds scenes from coded templates with the brand's type, colours and logo, records a synthetic voiceover or uses uploaded audio, transcribes captions from the finished track and renders MP4 files.
- Formats: 16:9, 9:16, 1:1 and 4:5, up to 1080p; captions burned in or as an .srt file.
- What it is not: not an AI video generator (it does not invent footage; AI writes the script and voice, the pictures come from the source) and not a timeline editor.
- Review: a studio where each video is reviewed before it goes out; batch runs turn one row, or one page from the site's sitemap, into one video. Rebuilds are kept as new versions beside the original.
- Delivery: MP4 downloads, delivery to a Google Drive folder the client owns, or publishing approved videos to a connected YouTube channel with a title, description, hashtags and tags written for the Short and the landscape cut.
- Who it is for: businesses with many things worth a video. Workspaces are set up for vehicles and equipment, boats and marine, property, products and e-commerce, software and apps, media and publishing, or services.
- Pricing (launch pricing, US dollars): Starter $79 a month for 50 videos; Growth $249 a month for 250; Scale $599 a month for 750; Custom from 1,500 videos a month. Extra videos cost $1.50, $1.00 and $0.80. A video is one finished render up to 2 minutes; re-rendering the same video in the same month is free. Seats and brands are included in each plan.
- Status: coming soon. Choosing a plan joins the launch list; there is no charge today.
- Built with: Remotion, ffmpeg, headless Chrome, ElevenLabs and Whisper.

## Product

- [Videngine: turn a URL into a finished video](https://videngine.io): Videngine is a programmatic video engine. Give it a link, a product page or a row of data and get back a rendered, narrated, captioned video. No editor.
- [Pricing: plans from $79 a month](https://videngine.io/pricing): Videngine pricing. Four plans priced by finished video, from $79 a month for 50 videos. Team seats and brands included, re-renders free, no per-minute maths.
- [What is programmatic video? A plain definition](https://videngine.io/programmatic-video): Programmatic video is rendered from a coded template and structured data, so one template makes many videos. A plain definition, and when to use it.

- [AI video ad maker: ads and marketing videos from your content](https://videngine.io/use-cases/video-ads): Use an AI video ad maker on your own listings, pages and data: which ads to automate, a 20-second ad plan, formats by placement, variants and cost.
- [Product video automation: from catalogue to ad variants](https://videngine.io/notes/product-video-automation): Build a product video workflow with accurate variants, a reusable scene plan, controlled creative tests and a process for refreshing outdated videos.
- [Explainer video maker: turn your writing into clear explainers](https://videngine.io/use-cases/explainer-videos): Use an explainer video maker to turn help articles, release notes and guides into narrated, captioned videos: structure, scripts, scene plans and limits.
- [YouTube video maker for businesses: videos from your pages](https://videngine.io/use-cases/youtube-videos): A YouTube video maker for businesses: turn listings, products and articles into narrated videos and Shorts, with metadata, review and channel publishing.
- [Short-form video maker: Shorts, Reels and TikTok at scale](https://videngine.io/use-cases/short-form-video): A short-form video maker for businesses: turn listings, products and articles into vertical Shorts, Reels and TikToks with burned-in captions, in batches.
- [Real estate listing video: a narrated video for every property](https://videngine.io/use-cases/real-estate-video): A real estate listing video for every property: narrated, captioned 9:16 and 16:9 cuts from the listing's photos and facts, kept accurate as prices change.

- [Photos to video: turn pictures into a narrated video](https://videngine.io/notes/photos-to-video): Photos to video, step by step: order the pictures, time each one, add narration and captions, frame for 9:16 and 16:9, and know when AI image-to-video fits.
- [AI video generator costs: compare the full production bill](https://videngine.io/notes/ai-video-generator-cost): Compare AI video tool costs across subscriptions, credits, generated footage, rendering, retries and review using cost per approved video.
- [URL to video: how to turn a webpage into a useful video](https://videngine.io/notes/url-to-video): A practical URL-to-video workflow: choose the right source, check extracted facts, plan scenes and evaluate tools before automating production.
- [Article to video: turn a blog post into a clear explainer](https://videngine.io/notes/article-to-video): Turn articles into videos with an editorial workflow for choosing one answer, writing a spoken script, matching visuals and reviewing captions.
- [Bulk video creation from a CSV: a reliable workflow](https://videngine.io/notes/bulk-video-creation-from-csv): How to structure a spreadsheet for bulk video creation, validate rows, track failures and estimate render volume without losing control of quality.

- [Videngine vs Creatomate: a Creatomate alternative for listing videos](https://videngine.io/vs/creatomate): Creatomate is a template editor and API for data-driven video. Videngine is a finished listing-video product. Scripts, voice, review and price compared.
- [Videngine vs Shotstack: a Shotstack alternative for listing videos](https://videngine.io/vs/shotstack): Shotstack is a video editing API for developers. Videngine is a finished product for listing videos. Pricing, bulk rendering, voice and delivery compared.
- [Videngine vs Pictory: a Pictory alternative for listing videos](https://videngine.io/vs/pictory): Pictory turns articles and scripts into stock-footage videos. Videngine turns listings into videos of the real item for sale. Plans and prices compared.
